as_told.title: Edgar Cayce's Hall of Records beneath the Sphinx

plain: Beneath the Great Sphinx at Giza in Egypt, the story goes, lies a hidden chamber holding an ancient library, a "hall of records." A guest named Matt LaCroix says "we're told by things like Edgar Cayce and others" that such a library was supposed to be under the Sphinx, Cayce being a man known for his visions. A researcher named Luke Caverns tells it as Cayce's own vision, dated to the 1940s, of a chamber whose records "tell the story of Atlantis," the legendary lost civilisation. If true, a written account of a forgotten world would be sitting under one of Egypt's best known monuments.
